attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Isolated view/JS change to a single Razor template (color picker for text fields) with id-scoping fixes to support multiple instances, but initial page-load re-run of setColorField on every load could subtly alter previously-saved color values (e.g., normalizing #RGB/#RGBA to #RRGGBB[AA] or resetting on unexpected formats) and it changes the input from a color-typed asp-for field to a hidden field, which could affect any custom CSS/JS/themes that targeted the old #color/#color_wrapper IDs."}
